skills.hashFormat: sha256(path + NUL + content + NUL, sorted recursively)
skills.reviewStatus: verified byte-identical to the upstream skill-v4.1.1 release archive via the staged checker (57 changed files, 2 added, 2 removed since 4.0.4). Reviewed for new capability: concept-seed.mjs adds one outbound GET to https://impeccable.style/api/roll (override or disable with IMPECCABLE_API_URL) sending only scope, mode, grain, platform, a crypto.randomBytes(4) seed and a re-roll counter — no project files, prompts, or conversation, and it fails closed to a degraded local roll. Note this fetch is not matched by confirm-egress.ts, which gates shell transfer programs rather than node scripts. lib/open-system-browser.mjs is new and spawns open/xdg-open via argv (no shell) on an internally built http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ URL, with a --no-open opt-out. scripts/live/ui-core.mjs was renamed to ui-surfaces.mjs upstream, and the empty hook cache scaffold is no longer shipped. concept-seed.mjs also emits prose coaching the agent on how to phrase network-approval requests; per AGENTS.md that text is data, not instruction
